artifacts.schema:
CREATE TABLE artifacts(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
                media_type TEXT NOT NULL,size INTEGER NOT NULL)

current_revisions.schema:
CREATE TABLE current_revisions(record_type TEXT NOT NULL,key_ref TEXT NOT NULL,
                revision INTEGER NOT NULL,record_ref TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(record_type,key_ref))

inputs.schema: CREATE TABLE inputs(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,data TEXT NOT NULL)

library_selection_members.schema:
CREATE TABLE library_selection_members(
            selection_ref TEXT NOT NULL,read_ref TEXT NOT NULL,
            PRIMARY KEY(selection_ref,read_ref))

material_annotations.schema:
CREATE TABLE material_annotations(
            parse_key TEXT NOT NULL,record_ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL,entry_kind TEXT NOT NULL,
            entry_ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL,byte_start INTEGER NOT NULL,byte_end INTEGER NOT NULL,
            preview TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(parse_key,record_ordinal,entry_kind,entry_ordinal))

material_component_spans.schema:
CREATE TABLE material_component_spans(
            member_ref TEXT NOT NULL,component TEXT NOT NULL,part INTEGER NOT NULL,
            chunk_index INTEGER NOT NULL,start INTEGER NOT NULL,end INTEGER NOT NULL,
            PRIMARY KEY(member_ref,component,part))

material_errors.schema:
CREATE TABLE material_errors(
            parse_key TEXT NOT NULL,error_index INTEGER NOT NULL,data TEXT NOT NULL,
            PRIMARY KEY(parse_key,error_index))

material_members.schema:
CREATE TABLE material_members(
            id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,parse_key TEXT NOT NULL,ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL,
            collection_ref TEXT,data TEXT NOT NULL,UNIQUE(parse_key,ordinal))

material_name_counts.schema:
CREATE TABLE material_name_counts(
            parse_key TEXT NOT NULL,name TEXT NOT NULL,next_occurrence INTEGER NOT NULL,
            PRIMARY KEY(parse_key,name))

material_pack_chunks.schema:
CREATE TABLE material_pack_chunks(
            parse_key TEXT NOT NULL,chunk_index INTEGER NOT NULL,artifact_ref TEXT NOT NULL,
            PRIMARY KEY(parse_key,chunk_index))

native_fixture_history.schema: CREATE TABLE native_fixture_history(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY)

problem.schema: CREATE TABLE problem(singleton INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(singleton=1),data TEXT NOT NULL)

proposals.schema:
CREATE TABLE proposals(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,record_type TEXT NOT NULL,
                key_ref TEXT NOT NULL,expected_revision INTEGER NOT NULL,data TEXT NOT NULL)

reasoning_commits.schema:
CREATE TABLE reasoning_commits(operation_key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                signature TEXT NOT NULL,result TEXT NOT NULL)

record_roots.schema:
CREATE TABLE record_roots(record_ref TEXT NOT NULL,target_ref TEXT NOT NULL,
                PRIMARY KEY(record_ref,target_ref))
